name: smwgraphics-tetris-block-beach
title: Tetris Block Beach
description:
Broken old Tetris blocks scattered alongside the beach. The green on the bottom row is like mold growing. The current palette was made for sunset.

This comes with everything you need for both new and older versions of LM. This overrides the entire palette 7 row, and the end few palettes of palette 6.

Credit if used please!
